text: This device is intended for indoor use only (Please place this device in a similar indoor environment when using it outdoors, e.g. Home RVs, tents, cabins, etc.).
※ This device is not waterproof or dustproof. Keep away from rain and humid environments during use.
The LCD turns oﬀ automatically and enters sleep mode after 2 minutes of inactivity.
Double-click the Main Power Button when the LCD screen is on.
You can also set the screen display mode in the Jackery App.
